items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an in-page action, form submission, or declarative dialog/popover command. For URL navigation, use LinkButton instead.

items.name: link-button
items.title: LinkButton
items.description: Navigates to a URL using a semantic `<a>` element styled to match Button variants. Never overrides link semantics with `role="button"`.
